title: Class 6 UAP shuts down three systems after a directed-energy weapon is aimed at it
place_text: Western United States, hilltop at a government event

tellings.quote: Somewhere around 2003 we spent the year west, and we had opportunity to bring for a government event energy weapon.
>> and it just shut down the directed energy before it even went out.
tellings.difference: Told secondhand by Jesse Michels, who calls the object a jellyfish UAP and puts it in the 2020s rather than c. 2003.
tellings.link_reason: Both describe a UAP disabling Skywatcher's directed-energy weapon before it could fire, at a government event.

as_told.title: Jellyfish UAP shut down a directed energy weapon

plain: The story is that a strange object, called a 'class 6' UAP (UAP being the government's current term for UFOs), switched off a directed-energy weapon, a weapon that fires a focused beam of energy, when it was pointed at it. A member of Skywatcher, a startup that says it can call UFOs into view, tells it on the show as something they took part in. They say that around 2003 they spent a year in the western United States and had the chance to bring an energy weapon to a government event on a hilltop. As they tell it, when the weapon was aimed at the object, three systems shut down. If true, the object could defeat a weapon before it fired. Michels tells a version he heard from a man named James Fowler, in which a 'jellyfish' shaped object 'just shut down the directed energy before it even went out.' His version places it in the 2020s, not around 2003.
